_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Ninety-Day Report - Production, Qualification, and Engineering Testing
summary: Specifies the ninety-day test schedule information required for units subject to Production, Qualification, Engineering Change Proposal, and Engineering Testing using government test facilities.
use_relationship:
The Ninety Day Report schedule information is required for units that are to be subjected to Production, Qualification, Engineering Change Proposal (ECP), and Engineering Testing (engineering testing utilizing government test facilities only). The information is required for items that are proposed for testing within the following 90 days.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains format and content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in Microsoft (MS) Excel format, Arial 10 point font and all cells set to wrap text, Columns A, B, L, and M are reserved and will be left blank. Note that Table 1 below is shown with the columns hidden.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the following:

children.title: Title
children.content: Company name, 90-day report, and day of week followed by date created.

children.title: Title
children.content: Test location and months covered reported.

children.title: "AN/SSQ" represents the sonobuoy type
children.content: "AN/SSQ" represents the sonobuoy type Q-36, 53, 62, 101, or 125; lowest type # first.

children.title: "CONT #" represents the last 7 digits
children.content: "CONT #" represents the last 7 digits of the contract number.

children.title: "# TO TEST" represents the quantity
children.content: "# TO TEST" represents the quantity of sonobuoys to be tested.

children.title: "ETA @ SITE" represents estimated time
children.content: "ETA @ SITE" represents estimated time of arrival at the test site or site receiving location.

children.title: "DAY DATE" represents the day of
children.content: "DAY DATE" represents the day of the week and date of ETA.

children.title: "DCMA DATE" represents the date or
children.content: "DCMA DATE" represents the date or estimated date of lot test sample selection.

children.title: "45-DAY CLOCK" represents 45 days after
children.content: "45-DAY CLOCK" represents 45 days after lot sample selection and date of DCMA final inspection.

children.title: "TEST TYPE" represents the type of
children.content: "TEST TYPE" represents the type of test to be conducted.

children.title: "NOTES" represents place holder for
children.content: "NOTES" represents place holder for any comments, special requests, or general information.
